name: NeuMesh++
aliases: Learning Disentangled Neural Mesh-Based Implicit Field
Learning Disentangled Neural Mesh-Based Implicit Field for Geometry and Texture Editing
definition: A mesh-based neural radiance representation that encodes the scene with disentangled geometry, texture, and semantic codes on mesh vertices to enable efficient volumetric editing.
summary: NeuMesh++ is a mesh-based neural radiance field that enables high-fidelity novel view synthesis and fine-grained 3D editing without UV mapping or teacher models by using disentangled latent codes on a mesh scaffold.
